hebrew-question-words.title: Repair: question signals
hebrew-question-words.move: A question signal tells you the source is opening an inquiry about a boundary or reason.
hebrew-question-words.check: What kind of word is מֵאֵימָתַי?

source-signals.title: Repair: hear the source first
source-signals.move: Before later interpretation, name who is addressed and what is affirmed.

liturgical-function.title: Repair: name prayer's function
liturgical-function.move: Ask whether a line offers praise, petition, thanks, or another liturgical function.
liturgical-function.check: Is a request for healing praise or petition?

canonical-reception.title: Repair: trace a source chain
canonical-reception.move: A later source can receive an earlier verse for a new, concrete question without erasing it.
canonical-reception.check: What should you trace after reading the Torah verse?

identify-conceptual-claim.title: Repair: distinguish topic from claim
identify-conceptual-claim.translation: Bring it back to your heart.
identify-conceptual-claim.move: A claim says something interpretable; a topic merely names a subject.
identify-conceptual-claim.check: Complete: knowledge should be brought into one's…

conceptual-application.title: Repair: apply with restraint
conceptual-application.move: A character source may invite a modest practice without becoming a ruling for every case.
conceptual-application.check: What kind of practice should follow a Mussar source?

historical-context.title: Repair: locate a source
historical-context.translation: Seek the welfare of the city.
historical-context.move: Ask speaker, audience, setting, and purpose before using a text in a larger comparison.
